blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Looped Transformers offer a parameter-efficient approach to language modeling by repeatedly applying a shared backbone. Vanilla looped Transformers use each backbone output directly as the input to the next iteration. These outputs may contain information useful several iterations later, but retaining it across the loop depends entirely on the single hidden state. We introduce StateLoop, which maintains one additional persistent state per token to retain information across iterations. At each iteration, a learned gate controls how much of the previous state is retained and how much information from the backbone output is incorporated. The updated state is projected back and added to the backbone output for subsequent iterations and final prediction. This design reduces Pile perplexity and improves average accuracy across eight zero-shot tasks over Vanilla Looped. Its perplexity advantage over Vanilla Looped grows with trained loop depth, consistent with persistent state becoming increasingly useful as recurrent computation deepens.
blocks.zh: 循环变换器通过反复应用共享的主干线,为语言建模提供了一个参数高效的方法. 香草环绕变形器直接使用每个主干输出作为下一个迭代的输入. 这些输出可能包含一些后期有用的信息迭代,但在整个循环中保留它完全取决于单个隐藏状态. 我们引入了StateLoop,它保持一个额外的持久状态,每个代号保留信息。 在每次迭代时,一个有学识的门控制了以前状态保留了多少,以及从主干输出吸收了多少信息. 更新后的状态将回向并添加到骨干输出中,用于后续的迭代和最终预测. 这种设计降低了Pile通透性,并改进了Vanilla Looped上八个零发任务的平均精度. 其相对于"香草环绕"(Vanilla Looped)的通畅性优势随着训练有素的环绕深度而增长,与持续的状态相符合,随着经常性计算深化而变得日益有用.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Looped Transformers increase computation by repeatedly applying a shared backbone ( Dehghani et al., 2019 ) . Saunshi et al. (2025) show that looped models improve language modeling over non-looped models with the same number of parameters. Ouro demonstrates this approach at larger scale, with 1.4B and 2.6B looped models achieving performance comparable to larger standard Transformers across downstream benchmarks ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 循环变换器通过反复应用共享主干线来增加计算(Dehghani等,2019年). Saunshi 等 (2025) 显示被环绕的模型改进了语言模型,而不是使用同样数量的参数的非螺旋模型. Ouro在更大的规模上演示了这一方法,1.4B和2.6B环绕模型的性能与跨下游基准的更大标准变换器(Zhu等,2025年)相仿.

blocks.en: The design of connections between iterations is a central architectural consideration in looped Transformers. Vanilla looped Transformers use each backbone output directly as the input to the next iteration. As Pagliardini et al. (2024) show, DenseFormer achieves lower perplexity when later layers can access much earlier outputs than when access is restricted to recent outputs. This finding motivates the hypothesis that information produced in one iteration may likewise remain useful several iterations later. In vanilla looped Transformers, retaining such information across iterations relies entirely on the same hidden state that also supplies the input for subsequent backbone computation.
blocks.zh: 迭代间连接的设计是循环变形器中的核心建筑考虑. 香草环绕变形器直接使用每个主干输出作为下一个迭代的输入. 正如Pagliardini等人(2024年)所显示的,DenseFormer在较后几层可以访问更早的输出时,比访问限于最近输出时,实现了更低的迷惑. 这一结论促使人们假设,在一个迭代中生成的信息在以后仍然有用。 在香草环绕变形器中,在整个迭代中保留此类信息完全依赖于同样隐藏状态,同时为后续主干计算提供输入.

blocks.en: We therefore propose StateLoop, which maintains an additional persistent state for each token. The state is carried across iterations and updated by combining its previous value with a projection of the backbone output. A gate determined by the same output controls how much of the previous state is retained and how much new information is written. An optional state mixer uses causal attention or Mamba-2 to exchange information across token positions before readout. The updated state is projected back and added to the backbone output, making the retained information available to later iterations and final prediction.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们建议国家环球联盟(StateLoop),它保持每个标志的额外持久状态。 状态通过迭代来进行并进行更新,将之前的数值与主干输出的预测相结合. 由同一种输出决定的闸门控制上一个状态保留了多少,写了多少新信息. 一个可选状态混音器在读取前使用因果注意或曼巴-2在符号位置之间交换信息. 更新后的状态将回向并添加到主干输出中,使所保留的信息提供给后期迭代和最终预测.

blocks.en: We evaluate StateLoop at 410M and 1.4B scales to assess both its performance and the contribution of the persistent state. Compared with Vanilla Looped, StateLoop reduces Pile perplexity by 0.18 and improves average accuracy across eight zero-shot tasks by 0.97 percentage points at 1.4B. Adding causal attention and Mamba-2 state mixers further increases the accuracy gains over Vanilla Looped to 1.43 and 1.44 percentage points, respectively. We further analyze the role of the persistent state. Resetting the state at every iteration increases perplexity, supporting the value of carrying information across iterations. Moreover, StateLoop’s advantage over Vanilla Looped grows with trained loop depth, suggesting that persistent state becomes increasingly useful as recurrent computation deepens.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: The Universal Transformer introduced recurrent computation across depth by repeatedly applying a shared block ( Dehghani et al., 2019 ) . Subsequent work shows that looped Transformers can learn iterative algorithms for in-context learning ( Yang et al., 2024 ) . Ouro extends this approach to large-scale language-model pretraining with learned depth allocation ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 通用变速器通过反复应用共享块(Dehghani等,2019年),引入了跨深度的反复计算. 后作显示被环绕的变形器可以为内文学习而学习迭代算法(Yang等,2024. Ouro将这种方法推广到具有所学深度分配的大规模语言模型预训(Zhu等,2025年)。

blocks.en: Recent looped language models differ in how they carry information across iterations and construct the next backbone input. Parcae stabilizes the recurrent hidden state by constraining the spectral norm of its state-transition matrix ( Prairie et al., 2026 ) . PonderLM feeds back a weighted sum of token embeddings, with weights given by the predicted token probabilities ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) . Hyperloop carries multiple residual streams across iterations and uses loop-specific hyper-connections to read the backbone input from these streams and write the output back ( Zeitoun et al., 2026 ) . These methods modify or enrich the recurrent stream itself, whereas StateLoop retains the direct backbone stream and introduces a separate persistent state.

blocks.en: LSTMs, GRUs, and selective state-space models update recurrent state along a sequence ( Hochreiter and Schmidhuber, 1997 ; Cho et al., 2014 ; Gu and Dao, 2024 ) , while Recurrent Memory Transformers carry memory tokens between sequence segments ( Bulatov et al., 2022 ) . In looped architectures, Adaptive Loops and Memory augments repeated computation with gated access to static learned memory banks ( Frey et al., 2026 ) , while Universal Transformers Need Memory studies dynamically updated memory tokens as a computational scratchpad for recursive reasoning ( Sapunov, 2026 ) . MeSH externalizes recurrent state management into a multi-slot buffer with iteration-specific read and write routers ( Yu et al., 2026 ) . StateLoop explores a simpler design point: it maintains a single continuously updated state per token, retains the main recurrent hidden stream as a direct path, and shares all state-update and feedback parameters at every iteration.

MeSH将经常状态管理外部化为多片地缓冲器,并带有特定迭代读写路由器(Yu等,2026.). StateLoop探索一个更简单的设计点:它每个令牌保持一个单一的连续更新状态,保留了主要的经常性隐藏流作为直接路径,并在每个迭代共享所有状态更新和反馈参数.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: StateLoop equips each token with one additional persistent state to retain information across iterations. It reduces perplexity and improves average downstream accuracy over Vanilla Looped, with optional state mixers based on causal attention or Mamba-2 providing further downstream gains. The gains obtained with both selective-SSM and GRU updates support the persistent-state design. Its growing perplexity advantage over Vanilla Looped at greater trained depths further highlights the value of persistent state for deeper recurrent computation. State interventions show that earlier states remain partially usable at later boundaries, while continued state updates are important for prediction. These findings support explicit persistent state as a promising design choice for looped Transformers.
blocks.zh: StateLoop为每个令牌配备一个额外的持久性状态,以保留整个迭代的信息. 它可以降低通畅度并改进Vanilla Looped上下游的平均精度,基于因果注意的可选状态混合器或Mamba-2提供了进一步的下游收益. 通过选择性SSM和GRU更新获得的收益支持了持久性状态设计. 它相对于经过更深训练的Vanilla Looped的日益复杂优势进一步凸显出持续状态对于更深入的经常性计算的价值。 国家干预表明,早期国家仍然在后期边界部分可用,而持续的国家更新对于预测很重要. 这些结论支持作为环形变形器有希望的设计选择的明确持续状态。

blocks.en: Our experiments cover models up to the 1.4B scale, with the controlled loop-depth analysis conducted at 410M. Extending this analysis to larger models can further characterize how persistent state interacts with recurrent depth.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验覆盖了1.4B级的模型,在410M进行了有控制的环深分析. 将这种分析扩展到更大的模型,可以进一步说明持久性状态如何与反复出现的深度相互作用。
